text: I will use the app because of the widgets they are well made and look nice, the thing which I didn't like was the prices I mean it's a habit tracker app in the end why are you charging me these ridiculous prices! apart from the widgets I don't see a reason why someone would choose this over any cheaper alternative. NO HATE but I don't get it.
author: Khalid “Southhill”
developer_reply:
Thanks for the honest feedback! 😊 We’re glad you like the widgets! 🙌 Habitoria is built by a small team of independent developers, and the subscription helps cover development, support and new features. 🚀
You can still use the app and widgets for free — the subscription helps us keep it ad-free. ❤️

text: love how this app is set up but I wish there were more color options for the app, instead of just blue <3
author: Ryker Brush
developer_reply: Thanks a lot for the feedback! 💙 We’ll definitely think about what we can do with more app customization. It’s not planned for the next few releases, though — for now, you can only choose a custom color for each habit. Thanks for the suggestion! <3

developer_reply: Thanks for the feedback. Could you please specify which features or screenshots you mean? The app should actually include more functionality than shown in the store images, not less. We’ll review the listing and make any unclear options easier to find.

text: I wish it wasn't so expensive ($4.99/week, $8.99/month, or $34.99 for lifetime). I have LOTS of apps, and none of them cost this much. ☹️ (I'm retired, so I cannot justify an expense like this right now.)
author: Cristina Escobar
developer_reply: Hi Cristina, we understand! Apps like Loop Habit Tracker, HabitNow or Habitica often charge more for fewer features. Our lifetime plan is one of the best deals out there. The free version is always available too — no pressure! Hope you enjoy the app. 😊

text: I’ve tried a few habit trackers before and most of them felt either too complicated or too “gamified.” Habitoria hits a good balance. It’s simple, clean, and fast. I open it, log my habits, and move on with my day. The progress tracking is clear and actually motivates me to stay consistent. Solid app.
author: Aleksey Lopukh
developer_reply:
Thanks a lot for the kind words
It means a lot to hear that Habitoria feels clean and easy to use - that’s been the main goal from day one.
Glad it helps you stay consistent. More improvements coming soon
